srs: The invoice payment system records Customer, Invoice, BillingService, and Payment; each has an id attribute. Each Customer can have zero or more Invoice records, and each Invoice belongs to exactly one Customer. Each Invoice uses exactly one BillingService, and each BillingService serves zero or more Invoice records. Each BillingService manages one or more Payment records by composition, and each Payment belongs to exactly one BillingService. Each Customer can reference zero or more Payment records, and each Payment can be referenced by zero or more Customer records.
